text:
Introduction
This
 document out lists the inspection check list I1 , to be performed on a weekly 
 bases as indicated by W1 
 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng Gamal Sayed 
 Soliman tested at 15 Sep 02, at Assuit 500 ME,
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Air compressor must be isolated.
Main air tank must be isolated.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Work
to be Carried Out
Check the indication of pressure gauge.
Drain the main air tank.
Check the frequancy of the automatic operation of the air compressor unit 
 by checking the air leakage.
Check the oil level of the compressor.
Check the indication of compressor's first stage pressure gauge.
